sources: The monitoring deck's 263 clippings plus every page of the full editions. Relevant = about AAP, the Punjab government or a state matter.
takeaway: {negative_share} of the {relevant} relevant stories were negative and {positive_share} positive; opposition statements drive most of the negative share. Government delivery stories (mini buses, Valmiki Tirath, police action) got good placement, while drugs, Moga and Jhota dominated the criticism.
well: Government events led front pages in its own words.
The 100 mini buses made the most front pages of any story; the Valmiki Tirath grant ran in 12 papers.
Police action is the largest positive theme.
Seizures and arrests, many in district editions, with DGP and SSP quotes.
The water and federal-rights line is landing.
River-water resolutions on TOI's front page; "BJP wants to snatch Punjab's water" in all three languages.
improve: Opposition attacks are the top negative theme; AAP's own replies are about a third of their volume.
Drugs is becoming the opposition's main weapon.
No government answer to the drug-survey demand; the chemists' halt is now a patient-access story.
Moga, Jhota and the OSD need responses.
Crime and drugs each made front pages; Jhota is in its third week with Akal Takht prayers on 28 October.
